# Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your GreenNode account. When enabled, in addition to your password, you must enter a one-time password (OTP) every time you log in. This way, even if your password is exposed, no one else can log in to your account.

GreenNode supports two ways of receiving the OTP:

* **Send OTP to your phone**: the code is sent to the phone number registered to your account (only phone numbers with the Vietnam country code, +84, are supported).
* **Google Authenticator app**: the code is generated by the Google Authenticator app installed on your phone.

**Settings on the page:**

| Setting                                     | Description                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Enable 2FA (Password and OTP) for Login** | The main switch. When **On**, the system requires an OTP every time you log in. When **Off**, the options below are disabled.     |
| **Send text to phone**                      | Receive the OTP via your account’s phone number. This method only supports phone numbers with the Vietnam country code (+84).     |
| **Phone number**                            | The phone number that receives the OTP (display only, cannot be edited here). To change it, use the Change phone number function. |
| **Google Authenticator**                    | Receive the OTP from the Google Authenticator app.                                                                                |
| **QR Code: Generate new QR code**           | Generate a QR code to link your GreenNode account with the Google Authenticator app.                                              |
| **Save settings**                           | Save your changes.                                                                                                                |
| **Cancel**                                  | Discard unsaved changes.                                                                                                          |

1.  **Receiving OTP via SMS**

    If your phone number has the Vietnam country code (+84), the “Send OTP to phone” option will be enabled so that you can turn this feature on or off.
2. **Receiving OTP via the Google Authenticator app**

* Click the **Generate QR code** button. You will be taken to the Generate Google Authenticator code page, where you can follow the on-screen instructions.
* Click **Save settings** to finish.

The system will send an email confirming that your 2FA authentication settings have been applied.

After you have completed the 2FA authentication registration, the login step will use different verification methods depending on the option you selected above.

* **For receiving the OTP via SMS:** right after you enter the correct username and password, the system will automatically send an OTP to your phone number. Simply enter the code you receive to continue logging in.
* **For logging in with Google Authenticator:** please open the Google Authenticator app on your phone, copy the 6-digit PIN displayed in the app, and enter it into our request form.
